C0.quote: This paper considers manipulation by groups of voters who have the same preferences.

C1.quote: we study conditions on the numbers of voters and alternatives
C1.note: Results characterise when unsafe group manipulation exists; primarily strategic behaviour. AX included because conditions are characterisation-style; weakly.

C2.1.quote: A preference profile is a vector P = (P1 , … , Pn )

C2.2.quote: Each voter has a preference, i.e., a linear order on X.

C2.3.quote: according to the true, sincere preference

C2.4.note: Reported preference P̃ separate from sincere preference P.

C3.1.quote: all its members use the same strategy (report the same insincere preference)

C4.1.note: Only ordinal preference comparisons; no utility, welfare, or satisfaction notions for voters.

C5.1.note: No welfare, efficiency, or distortion criteria evaluated.

VOT.quote_behav: a voter who aims to manipulate, may take into account
VOT.quote_info: having complete information about the preferences of the other voters
VOT.note: Complete information stated for the basic manipulation model; the group model builds on it. Group members assumed to coordinate on the same insincere report, while partial participation is evaluated.
